matched_surfaces.name: syscall_wrappers
matched_surfaces.description:
C/C++ library wrappers or consumers of Linux system calls. Treat signature,
errno, flag validation, blocking/retry, timeout, and fallback-path changes
as compatibility candidates when reachable from public APIs or commands.

instructions: Analyze only candidates in this shard. Use the repository paths from analysis.json. Do not infer compatibility findings from other shards. Emit confirmed findings only; use manual_review_required when a cross-shard dependency is needed.
